user.title: Set up State Class Manager
user.description:
When you press **Submit**, the integration sets itself up:

- The file `state_class_manager.yaml` is created in your configuration folder.
- An entry for this file is added to `configuration.yaml` under `homeassistant:` → `packages:`. A backup copy (`.bak`) is created first, and the change is reverted if anything goes wrong.

No manual steps are needed afterwards.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance is allowed.

init.title: State Class Manager
init.description: The manager is always reachable at /state-class-manager (browser address, bookmark, or a dashboard button with navigation path /state-class-manager). [Open manager now](/state-class-manager)
